verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships TestModel/FunctionModel for testing agents without hitting real model/production APIs, and Pydantic Evals for code-first systematic testing, and a community reviewer independently cites 'ability to mock the LLM client for testing' as a standout feature. However, there's no dedicated 'sandbox data environment' concept (e.g., isolated test databases, mock production data stores) — the coverage is limited to mocking the LLM call itself, not a full sandbox around dependencies/tools/data. Missing for 10: documented sandboxed data/dependency isolation beyond model mocking, first-party guidance on avoiding production side-effects in tool calls, and broader independent corroboration of safe test workflows.
